caption: The drawing depicts a single glass cruet, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The cruet is rendered in shades of blue and features a rounded body adorned with a pattern of raised circular bumps. The neck of the cruet transitions into a fluted texture with vertical ridges, leading to a narrow, cylindrical neck that widens slightly at the mouth. At the top is a stopper, also glass, which has two pronounced spherical knobs. The cruet has a handle attached from the neck to the shoulder, curving smoothly outward. There are highlights and reflections depicted in white and various tones of blue to give the appearance of transparent glass. No additional objects or decorations are present in the drawing.
title: Vinegar Cruet
